metadata.description:
Paper and reproducibility archive for unconditional effective identifications of selected one-place archimedean Stark packets over real quadratic fields. The work develops a uniform quadratic-support theorem, an effective Shintani index-two transfer with certified height rigidity, and a cyclic-quartic CM norm bridge. The record contains the paper and supplement as directly previewable top-level PDF and TeX files, together with a self-checksumming companion archive of exact case data, Arb certificates, correction records, and compact proof-checking programs.

metadata.title: Effective Archimedean Stark Theorems over Real Quadratic Fields: Quadratic Support, Shintani Transfer, and CM Descent
